reason: Check paired migrations, cross-engine schema parity, and UTC timestamp safety for grant records.
Check grant-required/expired/revoked denial shapes are sanitized and do not leak internals or trigger session-expiry handling.
Check SSH scope, step-up, credential audit, and secret-safety requirements remain additive and fail closed.
Check new logs/audit paths avoid credentials, tokens, endpoint values, terminal streams, command output, and sensitive evidence.
Check frontend does not persist grant material in localStorage or other long-lived browser state.
Check API/domain types and mappers avoid raw snake_case objects and unsafe casts.
Check frontend behavior uses typed API wrappers, tests, i18n strings, and existing UI patterns.
Check grant dialog/prompt labels, DialogTitle, focus behavior, and decorative icon aria-hidden requirements.
Check terminal enforcement remains before node load, credential resolution, and SSH dial across inline and managed credentials.
Check implementation stays within terminal-first JIT grant MVP and does not drift into CA/Vault/session-recording scope.
